notes: S1-FIX5 X1/§12.2 check 1c: the ESS signingCertificateV2 ESSCertIDv2 writes hashAlgorithm {id-sha256, NULL} explicitly. The DEFAULT of that component (RFC 5035) is {algorithm id-sha256} with no parameters, encoded 30 0b 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 01; {id-sha256, NULL} is a different value, so DER must encode it. The receipt is fully re-signed with the test TSA key (messageDigest recomputed, signature over the signed attributes renewed), so it is strict DER, the CMS signature verifies and the container is valid.
